I haven't set up the 09:00 digest. A scheduled job created from this session would only save its output locally and wouldn't reach your DM, so I left it unset rather than promise delivery.

I posted two messages to you here. The first wrongly said I have no scheduler at all; the second corrects that. I can post a #coastal-team digest to this DM whenever you ask, such as "digest since yesterday". Automatic daily delivery would need to be set up by whoever runs the workspace bot.
